decidedBy: the project owner, 2026-10-29, written onto the record by claude-opus-5-5 on 2026-10-29
policy: Eshtemoa of 1 Chronicles 4:19 is one of the sons of the wife of Hodiah, as the King James, the JPS, the NIV and Ohienko read the verse, and not Hodiah's grandson; his name is also the town his line founded.
source: Essenthos, on the project owner's decision of 2026-10-29 that Eshtemoa of 1 Chronicles 4:19 is a son of the wife of Hodiah

says.distinguisher: the Maachathite, a son of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham (1CH 4:19)
says.notes: Eshtemoa is named among 'the sons of the wife of Hodiah the sister of Naham' (1CH 4:19). His name is also the name of a town of Judah (JOS 15:50; 21:14), which his line is held to have founded.

rulings.why: 'And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite' (1CH 4:19): the Hebrew prints no 'father of' before Eshtemoa, so he is one of the sons.
